_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Service Action Review Board (SARB) Analysis Report
summary: The SARB Analysis Report provides an analysis for all safety, maintenance, and operations-related documents applicable to aircraft.
use_relationship:
The SARB Analysis Report will provide an analysis for all safety, maintenance, and operations-related documents applicable to aircraft.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract SOW.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall be in the Contractor's format.

children.title: The Report shall contain the following information
Title of Airworthiness Directive, Service Action, or related document
Contractor document number and revision
Contract number
Corporate name and address
Signature block(s) showing corporate release approval
Source of documentation
children.content: Source of documentation (e.g., FAA, Contractor, Aircraft Manufacturer, and Component Manufacturer) and documentation identification.

children.title: Summary of the issue affecting the aircraft, aircraft subsystem, component, or support equipment
children.content: Summary of the issue affecting the aircraft, aircraft subsystem, component, or support equipment and the issue resolution defined by the AD, SA, or related document.

children.title: Detailed information on the effects of the inspection/repair/modification
children.content: Detailed information on the effects of the inspection/repair/modification on performance, durability, part obsolescence, form, fit, function, installation and interchangeability.

children.title: SA effectivity information on affected aircraft
children.content: SA effectivity information on affected aircraft; landing gear; engines and APUs; air stairs; hardware part number changes associated with software changes; and Peculiar Support Equipment (PSE).

children.title: Compliance requirements
children.content: Compliance requirements (e.g., recommended, mandatory) and compliance time.

children.title: Related and concurrent ADs and SAs
FAA Notices of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM)
Recommended incorporation disposition
children.content: Recommended incorporation disposition (e.g., Incorporate, Attrition, Information Only, Incorporate in Long Range Plan, etc.), including category code for CFM engine SAs.

children.title: Disposition and incorporation histories of previous document revisions for the aircraft
Recommended maintenance level of incorporation
children.content: Recommended maintenance level of incorporation (Field or Depot).

children.title: List of all affected manuals relating to the maintenance and operation of the aircraft
Identification and definition of Maintenance Task Cards
children.content: Identification and definition of Maintenance Task Cards defining changes to the aircraft maintenance program.

children.title: Specific parts, kits, spares, tools, and support equipment
Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) effort to accomplish the SA
children.content: Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) effort to accomplish the SA, including kits, parts, and consumable material costs; number of man-hours for installation, including access (open/close) and any other undefined time requirements in the SA; and requirements for special tools.

children.title: Warranty availability
children.content: Warranty availability (if applicable), including parts and labor reimbursement.

children.title: For CFMI SB's spare parts categories 5-9 the contractor provided analysis report
children.content: For CFMI SB's spare parts categories 5-9 the contractor provided analysis report must include a brief explanation of the SB, the SB category, and a recommendation.

children.title: For the analysis and recommendation of each SA the Contractor shall include
children.content: For the analysis and recommendation of each SA the Contractor shall include (if provided in the SB):

children.title: A description of the applicable equipment, item with Part Numbers
children.content: A description of the applicable equipment, item with Part Numbers, including associated firmware and software.

children.title: A description of the service action(s) required, impacts related to the equipment or item
children.content: A description of the service action(s) required, impacts related to the equipment or item, Next Higher Assembly(ies) (NHAs), and associated end items including firmware and software, and interchangeability.

children.title: For companies that Boeing has authorization to forward service actions
children.content: For companies that Boeing has authorization to forward service actions, provide a copy of the associated service action; document and publication.

children.title: Recommendations related to previous and potential maintenance decisions
children.content: Recommendations related to previous and potential maintenance decisions, configuration modifications and operational changes.

children.title: Impacts to continued airworthiness
Impacts to Extended Twin Engine Operational Performance Standards (ETOPS) Configuration Management and Procedure (CMP)
Impacts to obsolescence
Equipment or item pricing and kit pricing with anticipated lead times
children.content: Equipment or item pricing and kit pricing with anticipated lead times (as applicable and when available in the Service Action).

children.title: Warranty information, when applicable
children.content: Warranty information, when applicable, inclusive of warranty start date and end date warranty.

children.title: Aircraft, engine, aircraft component effectivities
Associated labor hours
children.content: Associated labor hours (as applicable and when available in the Service Action).

children.title: A list of related SAs
Failure rates
children.content: Failure rates (e.g., MTBF, MTBUR) on affected parts and assemblies (if available).
